chapter: Billie Holiday, Basie leadership and studio work
title: Upcoming Paramount studio date
summary: Royal is always the one who sets tempos; tomorrow he goes to Paramount to supply Basie-Ellington flavor.

story.theme_name: Jazz musicians in the movies and film scoring
story.community_name: Jazz musicians on film and studio scoring

blocks.x: Oh, I always end up being the guy that

shows them what tempo to play it in and something about the tune. That's in practically every band. As a matter of fact, tomorrow I'm going to Paramount Studio to do something because it has an idiom of Basie and Ellington attached to it and the only reason I'm getting the job is because they feel as though I'm the most logical one to have it.

I don't know what it is. I'm supposed to play something to help out in some way, to give it a flavor or a taste of Basie and Ellington. I haven't the slightest idea what it will amount to or wh o's writing it. I don't even know the contractor that called me or the director.
Is it a motion picture film?
It's at Paramount, so apparently it's from a Paramount picture.
